about: Cinematic stills look: AI images with slow camera moves, composed music, word-by-word captions.

image.prompt: An antique brass hourglass on a dark wooden desk lit by a single candle, golden sand falling, dust in the air.
A pocket watch lying forgotten in wet grass at dusk, its glass cracked.

scenes.narration: Life isn't too short. We spend too much of it carelessly.

image.prompt: A weathered ancient Roman marble bust of a bearded philosopher in a dark museum hall, one shaft of light across the face.
An ancient Roman writing desk with scrolls, an oil lamp and a stylus in warm lamplight, no people.
Hands placing smooth river stones in a careful line on dark slate, soft side light, close up.

scenes.narration: Seneca rejects the common complaint that life is cruelly brief. We're given enough time to do important things, if we arrange it well.

image.prompt: Sand pouring out through a crack in a glass hourglass, grains scattering into darkness, macro shot.
A phone glowing face down on tangled sheets in a dark bedroom at night, cold blue light.
A small empty rowing boat drifting alone on a misty dark lake at dawn.

scenes.narration: The real problem is leakage: hours drained by distraction, indulgence, and drifting without purpose.

image.prompt: A winding mountain road stretching far into the distance at golden hour, seen from high above.
Sunrise breaking over a vast valley, light flooding through layers of mist, epic scale.

scenes.narration: We do not have a very short time, but we lose a great deal of it. Life is long enough for the most important things.

image.prompt: An arrow buried in the centre of a straw archery target, warm evening light, shallow focus.
Hands sharing bread across a candlelit wooden table, warm and intimate, faces out of frame.

scenes.narration: Or it can feel rich, when it's aimed at a few things that matter.
